title: Paper 4A: Structural Defensive Levers in Systemic Cyber Risk. Analysis program, specification and run outputs
description: Analysis program (PhDPaper4A.py, with the frozen cemt_core v0.8 embedded and hash-checked), the pre-run specification, and the confirmatory run outputs for the Paper 4A Structure study of the Structure, Time and Adaptation programme. Tag v12 is the frozen confirmatory code; tag v13 adds the labelled post hoc H3 correction and publication figures.
